questions.q: Which list contains the five main physical qualities?
options: Pulse, pressure, lung capacity, sleep, mood
questions.explain: Topic 1: the physical qualities are strength, speed, endurance, flexibility and agility (coordination).

questions.q: Which are components of a healthy lifestyle?
questions.explain: Topic 1: activity, nutrition, sleep, hygiene, no harmful habits and stress control make up a healthy lifestyle.

questions.q: What does the RICE rule for a sprain stand for?
questions.explain: Topic 2: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation is the widely used first-aid rule for sprains and bruises.

questions.q: Skipping the warm-up is one of the common causes of injuries in PE classes.
questions.explain: Topic 2: no warm-up or a too short warm-up is a typical cause of muscle strains and sprains.

questions.q: You count 18 pulse beats in 15 seconds. What is your heart rate per minute?
Which of these is a SUBJECTIVE indicator of self-monitoring?
questions.explain: Topic 3: subjective indicators are what you feel (well-being, mood, sleep, appetite); the others are measured.

questions.q: Which are external signs of STRONG fatigue?
options: Paleness or strong redness of the skin
questions.explain: Topic 3: strong fatigue shows as paleness or strong redness, unsteady movements and irregular, very fast breathing.

questions.q: How is Body Mass Index (BMI) calculated?
questions.explain: Topic 4: BMI = weight in kg divided by height in metres squared; WHO normal range is 18.5–24.9.

questions.q: What does the strength index compare?
questions.explain: Topic 4: strength index = hand strength (kg) ÷ body weight (kg) × 100%.

questions.q: In what order are exercises usually arranged in a morning gymnastics complex?
options: Legs first, then arms, then neck
From top to bottom: neck, arms, trunk, legs, then jumps and calm walking
questions.explain: Topic 5: the complex goes from top to bottom and ends with jumps, walking and breathing exercises.

questions.q: Morning hygienic gymnastics should be done to exhaustion with heavy weights.
questions.explain: Topic 5: it is 10–15 minutes of light, moderate exercises without heavy loads.

questions.q: Which Kazakh national game uses sheep knucklebones?
questions.explain: Topic 6: in asyk atu players shoot a knucklebone (asyk) at other asyks to knock them out.

questions.q: Which start is used in sprint (short-distance) running?
questions.explain: Topic 7: sprints use the low start with the commands 'On your marks' — 'Set' — signal; middle distances use the high start.

questions.q: The course syllabus lists the exact normative values (times and distances) for each grade.
questions.explain: Topic 8: the syllabus does not contain the normative values; ask your teacher for the table.
